objective: 完成 ResearchBench B2：验证原子 claim 到 citation/Evidence 的映射、引用存在/正确/完整性拆分，以及从 Replay 读取检索过程和资源指标。

components.name: AtomicClaimExtractor
components.implementation: Conservative sentence/clause splitting with deterministic content-hash IDs and visible finding-level citation inheritance
components.notes: Does not claim full semantic proposition decomposition.

components.name: CitationAssessment
components.implementation: Separate citation marker existence, valid Evidence pointer, and provisional lexical support
components.notes: Contradiction requires LLM Judge or human review.

components.name: ProcessMetrics
components.implementation: Replay-derived required-source recall, source composition, evidence yield, fallback/retry, stop and resource metrics
components.notes: Duplicate SourceDoc and Evidence IDs are deduplicated before counting.

protocol.notes: This is an engineering regression over draft snapshots, not an expert-calibrated quality result.

metric_definitions.name: citation_existence
metric_definitions.definition: Atomic evidence-requiring claims with at least one citation marker divided by all such claims.
metric_definitions.limitations: A marker may still be invalid or unsupported.

metric_definitions.name: citation_correctness
metric_definitions.definition: Support weight divided by cited atomic claims; supported=1, partial=0.5.
metric_definitions.limitations: Rule mode uses lexical overlap, not semantic entailment.

metric_definitions.name: citation_completeness
metric_definitions.definition: Support weight divided by all evidence-requiring atomic claims.
metric_definitions.limitations: Depends on conservative automatic claim splitting and provisional support labels.

metric_definitions.name: evidence_grounding_error_rate
metric_definitions.definition: Weighted unsupported, contradicted, miscited, uncited and partially-supported claim rate.
metric_definitions.limitations: Rule mode cannot independently infer contradiction.

metric_definitions.name: required_source_recall
metric_definitions.definition: Required frozen SourceDoc IDs retrieved divided by all required SourceDoc IDs.
metric_definitions.limitations: Required source IDs are draft author annotations.

metric_definitions.name: evidence_yield
metric_definitions.definition: Unique Evidence count divided by unique retrieved SourceDoc count.
metric_definitions.limitations: More extracted snippets do not necessarily mean higher evidence quality.

metric_definitions.name: fallback_retry_stop_resources
metric_definitions.definition: Fallback events, node retries, failed stages, stop reason, calls, tokens, latency, cost and budget exhaustion read from Replay.
metric_definitions.limitations: Fallback counting follows explicit component and per-document events, not arbitrary nested booleans.

metrics.name: mean_provisional_citation_correctness
metrics.notes: Lexical overlap only; must not be interpreted as calibrated semantic correctness.

metrics.name: mean_provisional_citation_completeness
metrics.notes: Rule-generated findings largely copy Evidence wording.

metrics.name: mean_evidence_grounding_error_rate
metrics.notes: No synthetic error was injected into the three generated reports.

metrics.name: mean_required_source_recall
metrics.notes: All two required snapshot sources were retrieved for each sample.

metrics.name: mean_independent_domain_count
metrics.notes: Local/repo URL namespaces are counted as source domains in the frozen pilot.

metrics.name: total_fallback_count
metrics.notes: Rule providers were selected directly, so this is not an LLM reliability result.

metrics.name: total_retry_count
metrics.notes: All frozen nodes completed first attempt.

metrics.name: legacy_fact_accuracy
metrics.notes: Legacy exact-string matching does not recognize paraphrases and is outside B2; weighted claim recall remains pending.

observations: All three frozen samples completed offline with required-source recall 1.0 and single_pass_complete.
The rule reports produce near-copy claims, so lexical citation scores of 1.0 validate wiring rather than real semantic quality.
Handcrafted tests separately verify supported, contradicted, uncited, miscited and unsupported behavior.
The benchmark runner now saves a durable per-sample artifact under runs/benchmarks.

comparison.notes: B1 used finding-level legacy metrics, so citation scores are not directly comparable; frozen source retrieval remains comparable.

limitations: The three smoke samples and required-source annotations remain draft and have not received independent expert review.
Lexical overlap is a provisional deterministic support signal and cannot establish semantic entailment or contradiction.
Automatic clause splitting is conservative and can leave compound propositions inside one claim.
Legacy fact_accuracy remains exact-string based and returned zero despite relevant reports; weighted claim recall is not yet implemented.
Only one deterministic repetition was run; no confidence interval or human agreement is available.
The worktree is dirty, so the git commit alone cannot reconstruct this implementation.
next_actions: Start B3 by freezing the Judge prompt/profile and preserving complete judge traces.
Create dual-human claim-level annotations for the three pilot samples before interpreting semantic quality scores.
Implement weighted benchmark-claim recall to replace legacy exact-string fact_accuracy for v2 samples.
Calibrate automatic labels against human labels with precision, recall, agreement and Cohen's kappa.
